newsitem.title: INDIA: At least 29 die as India bus falls into river.
newsitem.headline: At least 29 die as India bus falls into river.

text.p: At least 29 people were killed and 12 injured when a minibus they were travelling in plunged into a river in the northern Indian state of Punjab on Sunday, the United News of India (UNI) reported.
The news agency said the incident occurred on a state highway in Kapurthala district, some 350 km (220 miles) northwest of New Delhi.
